name: nested-sections-law-choices
body: source spec decisions 2, 3 and 4 were written as local constraint nodes rather than left as prose in the changed requirements. Resolution: requirements.constraint.section-depth-limit (attaches-to requirements.requirement.template-composition) records "no composition chain deeper than six heading levels, bounded by the syntax not a setting"; requirements.constraint.section-cycle-error-chain (attaches-to requirements.requirement.template-build-checks) records "cycles rejected at load, error names the chain sections/a → sections/b → sections/a"; `item` added to requirements.constraint.reserved-template-names. Depth-limit wording judgment: the source says both "Depth is limited by the syntax" and "no template chain may be deeper than 6 heading levels"; the constraint states both, tying the six-level bound to the six Markdown heading levels [autonomous — wording judgment].
